unit_attributes.statement: This invented public-display permit policy is a diagnostic document, not legal guidance.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, throughout the time the display remains open.
unit_attributes.statement: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must illuminate every public exit throughout the time the display remains open.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, throughout the time the display remains open.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, throughout the time the display remains open, unless an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period.
unit_attributes.statement: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must appoint an adult steward who remains on site throughout the time the display remains open, unless an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When an agency employee is assigned to supervise a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises for the entire period it remains open.
unit_attributes.statement: The duty to appoint an adult steward who remains on site does not apply when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period.

unit_attributes.statement: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, before admitting the first visitor, the organizer must give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For each inspection record required for a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises.
unit_attributes.statement: Each inspection record must identify the display, the inspection date, and every public exit inspected.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When a storm warning is active, unless all of the following conditions are met: the demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof; the agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes; and an agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.
unit_attributes.statement: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless the demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof, the agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes, and an agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When an agency officer authorizes an outdoor demonstration during a storm warning.
unit_attributes.statement: The demonstration authorization expires when that warning ends, and it does not authorize demonstrations under a later warning.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For displays held entirely before sunset.
unit_attributes.statement: For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer should place a readable map near the entrance.

unit_attributes.statement: The recommendation to place a readable map near the entrance does not create a duty to illuminate exits after sunset.
The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For the 30 calendar days retention period for inspection records.
unit_attributes.statement: Weekends and holidays count toward the 30 calendar days.

unit_attributes.scope_text: If an investigation is open when the 30 calendar day retention period ends.
unit_attributes.statement: If an investigation is open when that retention period ends, the organizer must retain the inspection record until the agency closes the investigation.
